_manual: One file = one sequence. Load can select multiple JSON files. See sequence_authoring.md for the full guide.
Required: FormatVersion=1, Name=nonblank string, RepeatCount=integer 1..9999, Steps=array (0..10000).
Each step requires nonempty CommandText, LineEndingMode=null/None/Cr/Lf/Crlf, DelayAfterMs=integer 0..600000. Name and Comment are optional string/null.
No unknown fields, duplicate keys, comments or trailing commas. Any invalid file or duplicate sequence name cancels the entire batch.

Optional TxMode=null/Terminal/Hex selects a step mode; null/missing uses the main mode at run start. Explicit modes preserve command whitespace. GUI Run applies mode and delays without response checks.

Optional CaptureMs=0..60000 (default 2000) and Expect=null or {Kind:text|hex,Value:literal} apply only to CLI/MCP runs. Actual RX is retained; a missing literal does not imply device failure. No regex, subsequence matching or branching.
Commands here are examples; replace them with your device protocol. Import never sends. Automation has separate stricter run limits described in sequence_authoring.md.
Load limits: 100 files, 2 MiB per file, 10000 total steps and 16 MiB total input per batch. Exceeding a limit cancels the entire batch.
